face.name: 猎物搜寻者
face.text: 扰魔。在本随从受到伤害后， 随机消灭一个敌方随从。
face.flavorText: 亚基新鲜登场，还在吱吱作响。

face.name: Seeker of Prey
face.text: Elusive After this takes damage, destroy a random enemy minion.
face.flavorText: When the Aqir come out sizzling.

face.name: 苦痛侍僧
face.text: 每当本随从受到伤害，&抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: 在他年轻的时候，他经受的是“快乐侍僧”的训练，但是训练成果并不如他想象的那么好。

face.name: Acolyte of Pain
face.text: Whenever this minion takes damage,& draw a card.
face.flavorText: He trained when he was younger to be an acolyte of joy, but things didn’t work out like he thought they would.

face.name: 累叠食尸鬼
face.text: 在本随从受到伤害后，&召唤两个1/1的脆弱的食尸鬼。
face.flavorText: 有一群脆弱的食尸鬼想要摆脱它们在回合结束时的命运。

face.name: Tower of Ghouls
face.text: After this minion takes damage,& summon two 1/1 Frail Ghouls.
face.flavorText: Once in a while a group of Frail Ghouls will try to escape their end of turn fate.

face.name: 格里什异种虫
face.text: 突袭。每当本随从受到伤害，&获取一张法力值消耗为（1）的格里什毒刺虫。

face.name: Gorishi Wasp
face.text: Rush. Whenever this takes damage,& get a 1-Cost Gorishi Stinger.
face.flavorText: This card is the wasp's elbows!

face.name: 托尔托拉
face.text: 嘲讽。扰魔。在本随从受到伤害后，&获得1点护甲值并使本随从获得+1攻击力。
face.flavorText: 托尔托拉在燃烧军团的入侵中毫发无损，但梦魇的腐蚀却深深地穿透了他的防备。

face.name: Tortolla
face.text: Taunt, Elusive After this takes damage,& gain 1 Armor and give this minion +1 Attack.
face.flavorText: Tortolla survived the Burning Legion’s invasion unscathed, but the Nightmare’s corruption really got under his shell.

face.name: 烬根毁灭者
face.text: 每当你的英雄在你的回合受到伤害，&随机对一个敌方随从造成3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 在菲莱克的火力之下，哪怕是最虔诚的自然信徒也难免要燃起来。

face.name: Emberroot Destroyer
face.text: Whenever your hero takes damage on your turn,& deal 3 damage to a random enemy minion.
face.flavorText: Under Fyrakk's assault, even those with the purest devotion to nature shall burn.

face.name: 灵知沙漏
face.text: 突袭。在本随从受到伤害并存活下来后，&其攻击力和生命值互换。
face.flavorText: 人人都在意它转得对不对，没有人在意它转得累不累。

face.name: Sentient Hourglass
face.text: Rush After this minion survives damage,& swap its stats.
face.flavorText: Everyone asks, "What is the time?" but never "How is the time?"

face.name: 脆弱的食尸鬼
face.text: 冲锋。在你的回合结束时死亡。

face.name: Frail Ghoul
face.text: Charge At the end of your turn, this minion dies.

face.name: 格里什毒刺虫
face.text: 造成 2点伤害。召唤一只2/1并具有突袭的异种虫幼体。

face.name: Gorishi Stinger
face.text: Deal 2 damage. Summon a 2/1 Grub with Rush.

face.name: 异种虫幼体
face.text: 突袭

face.name: Silithid Grub
face.text: Rush
